title: mymind hero
description: A huge white disc ringed by soft blurred light (tangerine at the top, rose at the sides, lavender below) holds a two-line oldstyle serif headline set very large and tight, a sentence with coloured outlined tag pills, and app pills (one tangerine button on phones). A wide preview frame overlaps the disc's bottom edge; as it scrolls in, a pale veil, a tangerine play button (scaling up) and a serif caption (rising) appear over it. The headline, sentence and pills rise in on load.
notes: leaves room at the top for the fixed mymind-header
the ring of light is CSS (conic gradient + blur) from primary, glow and chart-3; it suits light themes best
preview frame is a media slot; empty it shows a placeholder at the original's 1.41 aspect
name: mymind-hero
